description: Maintained semantic overrides. Imported tokens.json and kit CSS are reference inputs; edit this file for supported browser control colors. Values omitted in a theme inherit the dark base.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Opaque content surfaces only — chrome uses the materials and Liquid Glass layers, never these steps. `fg` reads 12.3:1 on it (15.1:1 in Root Light).

tokens.name: bg-secondary
tokens.usage: One step up from `bg`: cards, grouped rows, the inspector ground. `fg` 11.3:1, `fg-secondary` 5.6:1.

tokens.name: bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Two steps up from `bg`: wells, nested groups, the recessed track behind a control.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: The lifted surface — popovers, menus, sheets, anything carrying `shadow-elevated` or heavier. `fg` 10.8:1.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on `bg`, `bg-secondary`, `bg-tertiary` and `bg-elevated` — 12.3:1 on `bg` and 10.2:1 at worst in the base theme, 15.1:1 and 13.3:1 at worst in Root Light. Never `Color.gray`.

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text — subtitles, metadata, column values — on any of the four surfaces: 5.3:1 at worst in the base theme, 4.7:1 in Root Light. Still real copy, so it stays above the 4.5:1 floor.

tokens.name: fg-tertiary
tokens.usage: De-emphasised marks on `bg`: overlines, separator glyphs, placeholder rules. 2.3:1 in the base theme, 1.8:1 in Root Light — decorative only, never text that has to be read.

tokens.name: fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled label colour on `bg` and `bg-secondary`. 1.6:1 by design (1.5:1 in Root Light) — WCAG exempts disabled controls, but pair it with a disabled affordance, never colour alone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The system's one accent — the macOS 27 window blue, `#0a99ff` on the dark base and `#0078f0` in Root Light. Links, selection, focus rings, progress fills and the primary button. Never re-pick the hue: tint it with the `accent-op-*` ladder. As a mark or ring it clears 3:1 on every surface. As text it reads 5.6:1 on `bg` in the base theme (4.5:1 at worst, on `bg-tertiary`) but only 4.3:1 on white in Root Light, so use `accent-text` for accent-coloured copy.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text on `bg`, `bg-secondary`, `bg-tertiary` and `bg-elevated`: 4.5:1 at worst in the base theme; darkened to `#0064d6` in Root Light (4.7:1 at worst, 5.5:1 on white), where the plain `accent` does not clear 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-contrast
tokens.usage: White. Text and glyphs on a full-strength accent fill: 4.9:1 on `btn-primary-fill` (5.5:1 in Root Light) and 5.3:1 or better on `table-selected-active`. Never set it on raw `accent` (3.0:1 in the base theme, 4.3:1 in Root Light); use `btn-primary-fill` as the ground. On `status-error` it is 3.4:1, so keep that pairing to 19px+ bold or 24px+ text.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: systemGreen. The success FILL — dots, rings, bar segments, pill backgrounds. Darkened to `#299b45` in Root Light so it clears 3:1 on every surface (3.6:1 on white). Not text: use `status-success-fg` for the label, and say the word as well as the colour.

tokens.name: status-success-fg
tokens.usage: Success TEXT and glyphs on `bg`, `bg-secondary`, `bg-tertiary` and `bg-elevated` — 8.3:1 on `bg` in the base theme, 5.3:1 on white in Root Light (4.5:1 at worst).

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: systemOrange. The warning FILL — dots, rings, pill backgrounds. Darkened to `#c57300` in Root Light so it clears 3:1 on every surface (3.6:1 on white). Not text: use `status-warning-fg`. Aliased by `status-paused`.

tokens.name: status-warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning TEXT and glyphs on `bg`, `bg-secondary`, `bg-tertiary` and `bg-elevated` — 8.1:1 on `bg` in the base theme, 6.3:1 on white in Root Light.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: systemRed. The error FILL — dots, rings, destructive button backgrounds. Clears 3:1 on every surface; as text it is 4.9:1 on `bg` but 3.6:1 on white in Root Light, so use `status-error-fg` for error copy.

tokens.name: status-error-fg
tokens.usage: Error TEXT and glyphs on `bg`, `bg-secondary`, `bg-tertiary` and `bg-elevated` — 5.9:1 on `bg` in the base theme (4.8:1 at worst), 6.4:1 on white in Root Light, and 4.9:1 on a grey control fill (`fills-tertiary` over white, the alert and bordered-button grounds). Root Light deepened from #c4231c on 2026-10-11, which read 4.5:1 there.

tokens.name: btn-primary-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, a darkened accent so `accent-contrast` clears 4.5:1 on it — 4.9:1 in the base theme, 5.5:1 in Root Light.

tokens.name: btn-primary-on
tokens.usage: Label and glyph colour on `btn-primary-fill`. White, 4.9:1 (5.5:1 in Root Light).

tokens.name: btn-destructive-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a prominent destructive button (Delete, Remove), a darkened system red so `btn-primary-on` clears 4.5:1 on it — 5.1:1 in the base theme, 5.8:1 in Root Light. Raw `status-error` / systemRed under white is 3.4–3.6:1. Label it with `btn-primary-on`; destructive text without a fill is `status-error-fg`.

tokens.name: btn-secondary-fill
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, 8% ink in the base theme and 6% in Root Light.

tokens.name: btn-secondary-on
tokens.usage: Label on `btn-secondary-fill`, alias of `fg1`. 8.2:1 at worst in the base theme, 11.9:1 in Root Light.

tokens.name: btn-secondary-border
tokens.usage: Secondary button border, 15% ink, drawn at `stroke-hairline`.

tokens.name: btn-tonal-fill
tokens.usage: Tonal button fill — accent at ~20% in the base theme, 15% in Root Light.

tokens.name: btn-tonal-on
tokens.usage: Label on `btn-tonal-fill` — the accent hue lightened to `#4ab4ff` in the base theme and darkened to `#005dba` in Root Light, so the label clears 4.5:1 with the fill over any of the four surfaces.

tokens.name: field-bg
tokens.usage: Text-field ground. Follows `bg-surface` in the base theme and goes pure white in Root Light so a field reads as an inset well.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Resting field border at `stroke-thin` (1px) — the one place the system uses 1px rather than a hairline. 40% ink in the base theme, 50% in Root Light, so the edge, drawn over `field-bg`, clears 3:1 against every surface: 3.3:1 at worst in the base theme and 3.35:1 in Root Light (both on `bg-tertiary`). Raised from 35% / 43% on 2026-10-11, which read 2.8:1 and 2.7:1 there.

tokens.name: field-border-hover
tokens.usage: Field border under the pointer, one step stronger than `field-border`.

tokens.name: field-border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused field border, alias of `accent`. The 2px `focus-ring` sits 2px outside it.

tokens.name: field-border-error
tokens.usage: Invalid field border, alias of `status-error`. Always accompanied by an error message — never colour alone.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of an unchecked checkbox or radio button, drawn inside its `field-bg` box (alias of `field-border`). Clears 3:1 against every surface in both themes, so the empty control is identifiable without its label. Never a 0.5px hairline or `border-subtle` for these: at 20–25% they read 1.3–2.9:1.

tokens.name: switch-track-off
tokens.usage: Track of a switch in the off position, under the white thumb (on is `accent`). Root Light: 45% ink, so the track clears 3:1 against every surface (3.25:1 at worst, on `bg-tertiary`) and the thumb clears 3:1 against the track (3.4:1 at worst) — Apple's Increase Contrast treatment. Base theme: Apple's dark systemFill; the white thumb reads 9:1 or better against the track and the surface. Replaces `fill-primary` or `fg` mixed at 22–24%, which read 1.6–1.8:1 in Root Light.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: 35% ink in the base theme, 43% in Root Light — the emphasis border for a focused group, a drag target or a high-contrast separator. Clears 3:1 on every surface, so it can carry state on its own. Never a hard hex.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: Selected-row tint — accent at 15% in the base theme, 10% in Root Light. Pair it with a full-strength accent icon; the tint alone is not a status.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring, alias of `accent`, drawn `focus-ring-width` (2px) OUTSIDE the control with a `focus-ring-offset` (2px) gap, so it never eats the hit target.
